edits.fix:
Replace exactly:
### If you are asked to show you are not already married

Some countries ask for proof that you are not already married. The most common documents are a Certificate of No Impediment to Marriage (CNI) and certificates from a registry of births, deaths and marriages. <!-- fact_101 --> Your registry can provide a statement that there is no record you have been married before, a Single Status certificate or a No Record Result certificate. <!-- fact_102 -->

DFAT can issue a CNI in Australia, but some local authorities only accept CNIs issued in their own country, so ask before you order one. <!-- fact_100 --> Our explainer on [what a Certificate of No Impediment is and who issues it](https://weddedwonderland.com/expert-advice/what-is-a-certificate-of-no-impediment-and-who-issues-it) covers the Australian side.
